entities.summary: Weston Robert Schweitzer is an American former professional football offensive guard who played nine seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the San Jose State Spartans and was selected by the Atlanta Falcons in the sixth round of the 2016 NFL draft. Schweitzer was also a member of the Washington Football Team / Commanders, New York Jets, and New England Patriots.
